sections.Profile:
The Straight Shooter pinball machine was released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in January 1959. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, it is a single-player electro-mechanical game with a Western theme.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1959
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Western, Women, Wood Rail, Horses, Original Theme
